speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Where there is child sexual abuse content, the Police will also investigate, as appropriate.

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: And if the Government Parliamentary Committee (GPC) can form any feedback mechanism or support the Ministry in its work, we would be very happy to work with the Ministry in this review.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: I will ask my Ministry to liaise with the GPC.
